questions.question: How should I keep the battery over the winter when I'm not riding?
questions.answer: For winter storage longer than one month, keep the battery at 50–70% charge in a dry place between 10 and 20 °C, and top it back up to that level every three months [1]. Never store it fully empty, because if a cell drops below its minimum voltage it may never charge again, and that damage is not covered by warranty [1]. If the bike is stored outside for more than a day, remove the battery and take it indoors [3].
